caption: Meppeler Toren, Meppel
composition: Fifteenth-century brick tower with the 1827 cupola on dry Kerkplein · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Meppeler Toren rises from Kerkplein beside the Grote or Mariakerk, a fifteenth-century brick tower closed by the cupola that replaced the spire in 1827. The old canal here was filled, so the square is dry pavement, not a quay. The church is closed. The sky is overcast, about 10.7°C, with wind near 2.5 km/h and cloud cover about 85%.
